scope: Quiescent, linear, rigid-wall lossless two-chamber silencer. De-embedded buyer reference planes; 60 mm numerical port stubs, not a flowing hot exhaust or lined absorber.

implementation_support.geometry: Two chamber radii 55-70 mm and lengths 40-110 mm, neck 10-50 mm, offset 0-25 mm, 30 mm clearance and package <=300 mm including physical leads
implementation_support.leads: 10 mm physical leads but 60 mm numerical stubs; observer de-embeds the extra 50 mm
implementation_support.medium: rho=1.2 kg/m3, c=343 m/s, no flow, absorption, liner, thermal or nonlinear acoustic claim
implementation_support.frequency: 500-2500 Hz, 201 rung-1 or 401 rung-2 points; narrow resonances need refined support
implementation_support.modes: Port-only single propagating mode must be verified on the exact port cross-section; chambers can have higher modes and evanescent fields

validity.decision_needed: Science declares acoustic amplitude, port mode/frequency, medium/material and source-model applicability; no existing f13 validity registry entry is inferred

complex_R_T.note: Complex de-embedded coefficients, exp(+i*omega*t) convention and pressure normalisation

incident_reflected_transmitted_power.note: Watts at matched equal-area reference planes; signed plane flux and saved |p|2 integrals retained

TL_curve_and_intervals.note: Power-ratio dB curve and refinement intervals; p10/min are derived, not interchangeable

interior_p_gradp_u.note: Complex pressure, gradient/velocity and mesh/quadrature for local equation and wall checks

reverse_port_S.note: Reverse excitation with power-normalised port scattering amplitudes

propagating_mode_power.note: Every propagating order needed if port single-mode scope is exceeded; scalar R/T no longer sufficient

laws.statement: Laplacian p + k^2*p = 0 in uniform source-free fluid
laws.conditions: Linear constant rho/c quiescent lossless medium; explicit excitation boundary and rigid-wall normal velocity
laws.calibration: Weak field residual, normal wall velocity and mesh-order study on the actual element route

laws.conditions: Current rigid lossless route, no absorption or mean flow; account for all propagating port modes
laws.calibration: Independent plane/saved-integral closure in watts plus relative residual, frequency and mesh ladder; historical <=0.02% observation is not an adopted tolerance

laws.conditions: Resolved positive incident power, passive medium, matched normalisation and all modes; no active source inside
laws.calibration: Uncertainty-aware absolute power floors; zero transmission has no finite exact dB value and must not be silently clipped

laws.conditions: Use power, not a bare unequal-port pressure ratio; equal single-mode ports allow TL=-20*log10(|T|)
laws.calibration: Observer algebra plus power uncertainty propagated to dB; refine/mark UNRESOLVED at deep transmission zeros

laws.statement: Source amplitude a scales p and u by a and power by |a|^2; normalised R/T and TL are unchanged
laws.conditions: Linear source model and unchanged geometry/frequency; amplitude is an analytic control, not a new buyer action
laws.calibration: Matched amplitude controls outside singular zero-input normalisation

laws.conditions: Reciprocal quiescent medium and matched port bases; offset geometry may have S11 != S22
laws.calibration: Forward/reverse matched witnesses; science validates reciprocity and mode normalisation on the actual port model

laws.statement: Reference-plane shifts in uniform single-mode leads change phase, not normalised transmitted/reflected power
laws.conditions: Exact propagation/sign convention and 50 mm numerical extension; higher/evanescent modes require a different observer
laws.calibration: Matched plane locations and independent saved-integral check; detect port contamination rather than declaring candidate failure

laws.statement: Matched rigid straight duct gives R=0, |T|=1 and TL=0
laws.conditions: Analytic verification control outside the two-chamber design grammar, single-mode matched ports
laws.calibration: Complex phase, normalisation and mesh/frequency error; no absorption manufactured to close a lossless power gap

excluded_claims: No monotonic TL-versus-frequency, chamber radius or length law: resonances and interference can reverse the trend.
No equality of forward/reverse reflection for an asymmetric offset silencer.
A p10 TL buyer requirement does not imply every frequency exceeds that value.
No heated flowing exhaust, liner-loss, nonlinear amplitude or experimental credibility claim from this lossless quiescent route.

tolerances.recipe: Common README plan; calibrate complex amplitude and absolute power before derived dB and near-zero bounds

calibration.image_basis: Elmer image recorded in the silencer verification proposal, SPECIFIED_NOT_RUN; accepted f02 heat MMS is not Helmholtz/port/P2-tet acceptance
holds: Single-mode port proof and saved-integral closure

probes.proposal: Supported single-frequency/full-curve cases, low-attenuation and resonance edges, plane/amplitude/reciprocity controls; no solver runs authorised

review_owner: Carbon Validator and science; owner adoption remains reserved
